episodeTitle.en: Lessons on product sense, AI, the first mile experience, and the messy middle | Scott Belsky (Adobe)
episodeTitle.zh: 关于产品意识、人工智能、首英里体验和混沌中期的经验教训 | 斯科特·贝尔斯基（Scott Belsky，Adobe）

guestBioOfficial.en: Scott Belsky is an entrepreneur, author, investor, and currently Adobe’s Chief Strategy Officer and EVP of Design and Emerging Products. He founded Behance, an online platform for creative professionals to showcase and discover work, and served as CEO until its acquisition by Adobe. Scott is an early advisor and investor in several businesses at the intersection of technology and design, including Pinterest, Uber, Warby Parker, Airtable, and Flexport. He is also the author of two nationally bestselling books and founded 99U, a publication and conference focused on productivity in the creative world. In today’s episode, we discuss: • How to strengthen your product sense
guestBioOfficial.zh: 斯科特·贝尔斯基（Scott Belsky）是一位企业家、作家、投资者，目前担任Adobe首席战略官兼设计与新兴产品执行副总裁。他创立了面向创意专业人士展示与发现作品的在线平台Behance，并在Behance被Adobe收购前一直担任CEO一职。斯科特还是科技与设计交叉领域多家企业的早期顾问与投资者，包括Pinterest、Uber、Warby Parker、Airtable和Flexport。他还著有两本全国畅销书，并创立了专注于创意领域生产力的刊物与会议平台99U。在本期节目中，我们将探讨：• 如何强化你的产品敏锐度

title.en: Lessons on product sense, AI, the first mile experience, and the messy middle | Scott Belsky (Adobe)
title.zh: 关于产品意识、人工智能、首英里体验和混沌中期的经验教训 | 斯科特·贝尔斯基（Scott Belsky，Adobe）

summary.en: Scott shares lessons from a career of building and investing, focusing on the 'messy middle' between idea and scale where most of the real work happens. He discusses how to maintain craft and quality amid growth, the role of taste and persistence, and what he looks for in the products and teams he backs. The episode is an inspiring, practitioner's view of what it takes to make enduring products.
summary.zh: Scott 分享了他打造与投资的职业心得，聚焦于介于“想法”与“规模化”之间、绝大多数真正工作发生的“混乱中段（messy middle）”。他讨论了如何在增长中保持工艺与品质、品味与坚持的作用，以及他在押注的产品与团队身上寻找什么。本期是一位实践者对“打造持久产品需要什么”的鼓舞人心的解读。
